There were a lot of clothes in there near the end and they ranged from more inexpensive stuff like F21 and H&M to slightly more expensive clothes from Ann Taylor and J.Crew. I thought that was really generous of her, and took her up on the offer after double checking it was not a chore for her. Anyway, I saw his parents again weeks later and mom said, "You had some pretty decent stuff in there! I took and saved some for \[sister\]." I can't help but feel totally annoyed with this.
